# spoke_static_target (Resource)

Experimental environment-scoped target policy through Platform's normal publication-v1 API. Consumes one project reservation under a separately authorized environment principal. Only name, protection and retention are writable; runtime heads are observed. Retirement releases its reservation; coordinate recreation with the project catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use an explicit environment provider with that environment's machine token.
resource "spoke_static_target" "nightly" {
  management_key      = "site-nightly"
  binding_id          = "456"
  name                = "nightly"
  deletion_protection = true
  retention_days      = 30
}
# Selected bundle/generation and observed endpoints are read-only; no upload occurs.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_id` (String) Exact project reservation for this environment. A binding can be consumed only once; changing it requires a new management_key and replacement.
- `management_key` (String) Stable non-secret recovery identity unique per target in this environment. Use a new key when replacing a live target with another binding.
- `name` (String) Target label; policy updates do not restore runtime heads.
- `retention_days` (Number) Declared retention policy in days. This declaration does not upload or delete independent artifacts.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Defaults to true. Apply false before destroy. Pending work and selected runtime references still block retirement; this profile has no withdrawal API.

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) Observed application identity, nullable before binding settlement.
- `bundle_digest` (String) Nullable selected bundle commitment; never reconciled by Terraform.
- `configuration_digest` (String) Current declaration configuration digest.
- `desired_configuration_digest` (String) Nullable selected runtime configuration commitment.
- `desired_generation` (String) Observed runtime generation; Terraform never selects a head.
- `endpoint` (String) Nullable observed endpoint; this declaration profile supplies no hosted endpoint.
- `expires_at_ms` (String) Nullable observed expiry time as a decimal string.
- `id` (String) Canonical import identity: organization_id/project_id/environment_id/target_id.
- `last_observation_ms` (String) Nullable last observation time as a decimal string.
- `observed_bundle_digest` (String) Nullable independently observed bundle commitment.
- `observed_configuration_digest` (String) Nullable observed runtime configuration commitment.
- `observed_generation` (String) Nullable observed runtime generation.
- `operation_key` (String) Last observed retained mutation key, or the next mutation reserved by this plan. Each logical mutation uses a distinct key; expiry never permits reuse.
- `owner_id` (String) Principal that owns the retained management operation namespace.
- `readiness` (String) Observed runtime readiness, independent of management settlement.
- `reason` (String) Observed readiness reason.
- `resource_id` (String) Exact target ID.
- `revision` (String) Canonical decimal revision used to fence updates and deletion.
- `state` (String) Observed declaration state.
